description:
Found during parent task-85895a88a2484d8589046b2030efd445 step 1 at HEAD 4ee9efe1. `git grep -n 'deployment.rollback' -- apps/daemon/src/http apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-contracts.ts` returns no matches; createAffordancePort iterates BOOTSTRAP_COMMAND_KINDS then explicit providers, none offering rollback, although the async registry serves it.
The handler requires project target plus environment/toReceiptRef/restoreDatabase; `git grep -n 'toReceiptRef' -- apps/daemon/src/http apps/control-room/src` also returns no matches, while health/read exposes rollbackSha only. The incident UI cannot spend a daemon offer or identify the matching immutable receipt without fabricating authority. Ship the production offer/read binding before the parent card consumer.
definitionOfDone: The composed production affordance read emits deployment.rollback only when the daemon can identify a valid prior DEPLOYED receipt with image digest for the environment; missing/unverifiable receipt yields no rollback control authority. Exact project target and expectedVersion come from the handler's durable authority, not browser inference.

Expose a coherent daemon-owned environment, target receipt reference and SHA binding that the parent incident card can carry into confirmation and payload; explicitly define refresh/stale-binding behavior. Preserve exact-key readers and all affected shape consumers.

A production read-to-command round trip spends the emitted offer through the real command registry with environment/toReceiptRef/restoreDatabase, and asserts stable code/layer on refusal paths; human-only and MCP exclusion remain intact.

Run fresh focused daemon tests with nonzero executed counts, pnpm typecheck, and the control-room package gate when served read or decoder shape changes. Parent task-85895a88a2484d8589046b2030efd445 is the concrete consumer and must depend on this row.

implementationPlan.description:
LEAF FIRST: land the shared rollback-target resolver, with no consumer yet.

Create `resolveRollbackTarget(state: EnvironmentDeployState | null): RollbackTarget | null` where `RollbackTarget = { readonly imageDigest: string; readonly sha: string; readonly toReceiptRef: string }`.

THE RULE, and it is the whole point of the module: project `state.receipts` down to the receipts with `outcome === "DEPLOYED" && imageDigest !== null` - that projection is the deploy history that actually ran. The LAST of those is the running image; the one BEFORE it is the rollback target. Fewer than two -> null. Never use `previous` from EnvironmentDeployState: it is positional in the raw list and includes REFUSED receipts, which is the exact bug this row closes.

Document in the module header WHY the positional `previous` is wrong, citing deploy-ledger.ts:73 ("never collapsed") and rollback-command.ts:98-101 (the handler's admission rule this resolver mirrors).

Tests (rollback-target.test.ts), each asserting the returned receiptId, not just non-null:
- two DEPLOYED receipts -> target is the older one
- [DEPLOYED A, DEPLOYED B, REFUSED C] -> target is A, NOT B and NOT C (this is the arm the old rollbackSha gets wrong)
- [DEPLOYED A, REFUSED B] -> null: A is what is running, there is nothing behind it
- a DEPLOYED receipt with `imageDigest: null` is skipped, not offered
- one DEPLOYED receipt -> null; empty receipts -> null; null state -> null
- the returned toReceiptRef matches /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u, so it satisfies rollback-command.ts:47 by construction
